name: ai-content-critic
description: A cross-agent skill for critiquing AI-generated text, images, slides, posters, and UI with blunt, evidence-based feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Blunt, actionable critique for AI-generated text and visuals
interface.longDescription: Use AI Content Critic to find AI tells, bland writing, weak logic, visual artifacts, layout flaws, and credibility gaps in generated articles, images, slides, posters, UI screenshots, and mixed media.
defaultPrompt: Use ai-content-critic to review this AI-generated article and tell me what feels fake, weak, or generic.
Use ai-content-critic to roast this image and give me concrete fixes.
